content: Snipe-IT purchase/finance fields per asset: purchase_date, purchase_cost, order_number (PO), supplier, warranty_months (expiry computed from purchase_date+warranty_months). Depreciation is model-level (assigned via a depreciation record with months + optional minimum/floor value) using straight-line method; reports show current book value. Supplier is a first-class entity (name, contact, address) linked to assets/licenses/maintenances.
